name: Multi-UAV Task Assignment Benchmark
description: A benchmark for multi-UAV task assignment is presented in order to evaluate different algorithms. An extended Team Orienteering Problem is modeled for a kind of multi-UAV task assignment problem. Three intelligent algorithms, i.e., Genetic Algorithm, Ant Colony Optimization and Particle Swarm Optimization are implemented to solve the problem. A series of experiments with different settings are conducted to evaluate three algorithms. The modeled problem and the evaluation results constitute a benchmark, which can be used to evaluate other algorithms used for multi-UAV task assignment problems.
general_score_metric: total collected reward / objective value (higher is better)
reputation: Niche benchmark referenced in UAV and combinatorial optimization literature for comparing heuristic/metaheuristic approaches, but not a broadly standardized community benchmark.
notes: Instance- and parameter-dependent; compares heuristic/metaheuristic solvers (GA, ACO, PSO). Simulation-based and non-LLM; lacks large standardized train/test splits and can be sensitive to problem formulation.
